mapper.select: SELECT s.task_id, s.schedule_no, s.work_order_id, s.work_order_no, s.product_id, s.product_code, s.product_name, s.resource_id, s.resource_name, s.op_seq, s.plan_start, s.plan_end, s.setup_minutes, s.strategy, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, w.order_type, w.spec_model, w.plan_qty, w.unit, w.priority, w.bom_no, w.route_no, w.mps_no, w.demand_no, w.release_by, w.release_time FROM mms_schedule_task s INNER JOIN mms_work_order w ON w.work_order_id = s.work_order_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status IN ('0','1') AND w.del_flag = '0' AND w.status != '8' AND s.plan_start <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND s.plan_end >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') ORDER BY s.resource_id, s.plan_start
